test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Israel has been a __staunch__ ally of the United States.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Unsteady**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **The word 'staunch' means loyal or committed. (**वफादार या प्रतिबद्ध**)**

 
 
• Example: She is a staunch supporter of the team.
 
 
 
• The antonym of 'staunch' is** 'unsteady', which means unreliable or inconsistent**. (अविश्वसनीय या असंगत)
 
 
• Example: I am a bit unsteady on my feet.
 
 
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4, Unsteady.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, **Resolute**, means determined or unwavering.(दृढ़ या अटल.)
 
• Option 2, **Careless**, means not paying attention or negligent.(ध्यान न देना या लापरवाही करना।)
 
• Option 3, **Confused**, means unclear or uncertain.(अस्पष्ट या अनिश्चित.)

18c:T5d3,
The correct answer is "**Implementation**."
